verdict.rationale: gstack's host docs say each supported coding agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot, Antigravity and others) is defined as a typed TypeScript config, and adding a new host takes a single file with no generator or setup changes. That indicates one collection is generated for many harnesses. A compressed AGENTS.md digest also covers hosts without a full skill install. Missing for 10: concrete per-harness install instructions shown in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of non-Claude installs (community evidence centers on Claude Code).
